name: Pinzger
beschreibung: Hotel Pinzger is located in the center of Stumm, a village in the central Zillertal. The building is a traditional Tiroler guesthouse with wooden furniture and cozy furnishings. Stumm is an ideal starting point for hikes and excursions into the Zillertal. Guests can expect regional cuisine and a quiet place to stay. The rooms are functionally furnished and offer overnight guests a simple base for stays in the region.
